Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Major: furniture anchoring and couple pairing. Anchor a preset to a nearby placed housing item (indoor or yard) instead of just a fixed world spot — the offset corrects against the item's live position, so it still lines up after the room's rearranged. Pair with a partner over /tell from the Animations tab (invite/accept/unpair, no relay, session-only); while paired, clicking any preset or animation queues and highlights it for both of you (color-coded: your pick, their pick, both-ready) instead of playing immediately, and fires both together once you've each picked something. Saving a preset while paired relays its anchor and name to your partner, who gets a matching entry built from whatever they're already playing.
